'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Attempted assassination of Mustafa Al-Kadhimi]]
**A [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] is launched against the [[Baghdad]] home of [[Iraq]]i [[Prime Minister of Iraq|prime minister]] [[Mustafa al-Kadhimi]], injuring six members of his security personnel. Al-Kadhimi survives the [[assassination]] [[List of people who survived assassination attempts|attempt]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/drone-attack-targets-iraq-pm-who-escapes-unhurt-iraq-military-2021-11-07/ (Reuters)]
*Aftermath of the [[October 2021 Sudanese coup d'état]]
**Protests continue nationwide and an intensive [[civil disobedience]] movement begins in cities across the country, as pressure mounts on the [[Sudanese Armed Forces|military]] to transfer power back to civilian leaders. Police use [[tear gas]] to disperse the crowds. [https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-police-fire-tear-gas-as-anti-coup-strikes-start/a-59742247 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Niger gold mine collapse]]
**At least 18 people are killed during the [[mining accident|collapse]] of an artisanal [[gold mine]] in Dan Issa, [[Maradi Region]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-18-killed-artisanal-gold-mine-collapse-niger-2021-11-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia]]
****[[President of Serbia|President]] [[Aleksandar Vucic]] receives a booster dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] at the [[Belgrade Fair]]. [https://rs.n1info.com/english/news/serbias-president-aleksandar-vucic-receives-booster-shot-against-coronavirus/ (N1)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] receives 2,930,300 doses of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]] distributed through the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://www.unicef.org/ukraine/en/press-releases/unicef-delivers-close-3-million-doses-moderna-vaccine-ukraine-under-covax (UNICEF)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****Health secretary [[Sajid Javid]] urges citizens to get a [[booster dose]] and continue to follow COVID-19 restrictions over Christmas, amid an increase in the number of cases in the country. [https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-health-minister-sajid-javid-booster-coronavirus-vaccine-christmas-restrictions/ (''Politico'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
***[[Japan]] reports no deaths from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours for the first time since August 2020. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/japan-registers-zero-deaths-linked-to-covid-19-first-time-since-august-202020211108003634 (Asian News International)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Nicaraguan general election]]
**[[Nicaraguans]] head to the polls to elect their [[President of Nicaragua|president]]. Incumbent [[Daniel Ortega]] seeks his fourth term despite condemnation of the election by  the international community due to many opposition candidates being arrested and imprisoned. [https://edition.cnn.com/world/live-news/nicaragua-presidential-elections-2021-daniel-ortega/index.html (CNN)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 NASCAR Cup Series]]
**[[Kyle Larson]] wins the [[2021 NASCAR Cup Series]] championship. It is Larson's first career championship in NASCAR Cup competition. [https://nascar.nbcsports.com/2021/11/07/kyle-larson-chase-elliott-denny-hamlin-martin-truex-jr-nascar-cup-series-championship-phoenix-race-recap/ (NBC Sports)]
